notes.title: Just a quick update!
notes.content:
As you know it's been some time since my last update. Unfortunately there are certain things going on in my personal life that have meant I've not been able to so much as look at this.



I have decided that enough is enough and am trying to give it at least a little dev time each week, starting today.



There's just so much I'm looking to add to V2 and I think that any of you that have played the current build will really appreciate the changes. This evening I have squashed the bug that deterred me when other stresses were already getting me to my breaking point and because of that I feel much more positive about being able to continue within 2025.



My aim is to have V2 released before the end of the year but we will have to see how life treats me in the meantime. Thank you to everyone who has bought a copy and played it, and thank you to anyone who has wishlisted it, it really does mean a lot.



I will leave you with this rather gorgeous portrait of Psilo by TriCENAtopss (formerly RikuSayPoof).
